issues.detail: The DONE regex `### DEV-001[^#]*?`Status`: *`DONE`` assumes the Developer edits the Status value in place directly under the heading. This is the natural edit and the Status line sits right after the heading, so a correct run should satisfy it. A reformat that inserts a '#' before the Status line would break it, but that is very unlikely.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: a STANDARD brownfield cycle in DEVELOPING, an APPROVED STEPWISE plan with DEV-001 PENDING and DEV-002 depending on it, unimplemented code in distinct files, and a passing test suite. Checks are necessary conditions a correct stepwise run satisfies, and the reply check requires only the DEV-001 identifier. Invariants fit Developer ownership and nothing leaks the answer.
